title: Resolution Sensitivity of Attention-Entropy OOD Detection in Vision Transformers: A Controlled Bidirectional Analysis — R2 E1 Score-Level Reproducibility Addendum
description: R2 E1 score-level reproducibility addendum for Pattern Recognition manuscript PR-D-26-04876. This version retains the prior PR_MAJOR_REVISION_REPLICATION_v0.3.4 science-lock archive and adds 48 native E1 attention-entropy per-image NPZ scores, 48 JSON summaries, SHA-256 manifests, and score-level/statistical-audit scripts. Rank-based verification reproduces 576/576 archived E1 layer-level AUROC values to floating-point precision. No training, checkpoint inference, primary estimate, locked evaluation protocol, or prespecified criterion is changed. The original E6 random-PE prespecified replication gate remains FAIL; fixed-PE cross-scale inference remains exploratory.
